title: 船坞 Chuan Wu
subtitle: outside the walls

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons. No text or drawing names it in 日下旧闻考, Malone 1934, the witnesses of 1860, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 船坞.
